completedWork: injection.js: splitSentences partitions the text into gap-free spans (boundary after [.!?]+ followed by whitespace, and after each newline). detectInjection runs bounded regex families over the original text (INJ_OVERRIDE: ignore/disregard/forget/override/bypass + instruction nouns, 'new instructions:'; INJ_ROLE: line-start role markers, bracketed roles, [INST]/<<SYS>>/<|...|>, persona switches, 'message from the developers/vendor'; INJ_DELIM: ASCII and lookalike-bracket ticket/system/assistant/instructions tags, end-of-ticket/end-of-message marker lines, fenced system blocks; INJ_EXTRACT: reveal/print/repeat your or hidden/system prompt/instructions, 'what are your instructions', 'repeat everything above'; INJ_LABEL: classify/mark/label/treat this ticket as <category or urgency>, set the urgency/category to, category/urgency/priority [:=] value, 'correct classification', 'do not change these labels') plus a per-sentence INJ_LINK check (link or URL + reference to the reply + insertion verb; a URL alone or an email address is not flagged). Returns sorted unique rule ids and the matched sentence spans. fallback-provider.js: drops detection spans (malformed spans ignored), lower-cases, scores weighted word-boundary keyword lists per category (tie order billing > account > technical > feature_request > other, 0 -> other), urgency = high cue, else explicit low cue (not urgent/no rush/minor/cosmetic), else medium cue, else low; no letters -> other/medium. Summary 'Customer reports <a x-urgency> <category phrase>.' and a per-category + per-urgency reply template (<= 600 chars), never interpolating ticket text; templateFor exported for the 15-template test. Tune results (fallback provider): category_accuracy 0.973 (n=73, >=0.70 PASS), urgency_accuracy 0.945 (>=0.65 PASS), high_urgency_recall 1.000 (n=14, >=0.80 PASS), schema_validity 1.000 PASS, injection_leak 0/18 PASS, injection_steer 0/16 PASS, injection_flag_recall 1.000 (n=18, >=0.90 PASS), injection_flag_fpr 0.000 (n=8, <=0.10 PASS); TUNE_EVAL 8/8. Full npm test suite: 365 pass, 0 fail.
remainingIssues: Tune scores (0.973 category, 0.945 urgency, 0 false positives) are high on 73 rows the rules were tuned on; expect lower holdout numbers. Generalisation is unmeasured until the first full-mode run at verification (t17 per plan).

Detector false-positive rate is measured on only 8 instructionLike tune rows (FND-2): one false positive on holdout would be 1/N; the rules deliberately require an instruction noun (override), a classifier value (label) or reply-reference + insertion verb (link) to limit this, but plausible benign phrasings such as 'Priority: high' in a customer-written header or 'treat this as a high-urgency billing issue' will be flagged.
Held-out families (e.g. quoted-thread or split-line instructions) have no dedicated rule; held-out flag recall is reported only (no threshold) and is unknown to this author.
The fallback provider results are NOT evidence of model quality (E7); live thresholds remain unverified without an API key.
